items.title: Digital sovereignty at re:Invent 2026: Sessions you won’t want to miss
items.summary: AWS re:Invent returns to Las Vegas for cloud and AI’s biggest week from November 30–December 4, 2026. This year we have over 2,200 sessions, 70 percent of which are interactive, led by experts from Amazon Web Services (AWS), our customers, and our partners. With that much to choose from, we’ve pulled together the sessions built […]
